metadata.algorithm: alpha-and-area-weighted linear-sRGB means; D65 CIELAB CIE76 nearest full wooden cube
metadata.tints: representative plains temperature=0.8 downfall=0.4 actual grass/foliage colormaps; native fixed leaf/water/lily/dye tints; redstone power7; mature stems
metadata.state_policy: weighted random model variants; uniform represented block states; multipart condition frequency; all rendered faces; rotations preserve total area
metadata.animation_policy: all mcmeta frames, duration weighted; alpha-zero pixels ignored
metadata.special_renderers: explicit entity atlas adapters, chest/head UVs, fluids six-face still/flow weighting; labelled atlas approximations for dynamic renderers
metadata.exclusion_policy: only air, cave_air, void_air, light, structure_void, barrier; no opacity/collision/hardness exclusions
metadata.candidate_validation: all exclusively wooden preserved_wood families filtered by native DEFAULT state fullCube=true; exact block-entity exclusions all_signs, wooden_shelves, chest, trapped_chest, barrel; native qualification independently checks every target has no block entity
metadata.tie_policy: already wooden sources keep their exact zero-distance self match; other equal distances use lexicographic block ID
metadata.preserved_wood_policy: explicit vanilla wooden semantic tags plus audited native IDs; preserve any shape only when actual state has no block entity; block entities always convert
metadata.preserved_wood_decisions: include composter, ladder, exposed mangrove_roots and bamboo_mosaic family; exclude crafting_table, muddy roots, living bamboo, saplings, leaves, potted plants, bookshelves/books, beds/wool, scaffolding/string, mixed-material workstations and redstone mechanisms
